reviewer.origin: Agent tool, a fresh context with only this brief and its files, launched by the Inner Child lane session (https://claude.ai/code/session_01NbUfhcTaRT8sbjyYV1wEFq), turn 113, 2026-10-26

evidence: I judged 'When your kind words sound empty' over 'Maybe the words are all there, but the loving grown-up behind them isn't, not yet ... I'd borrow that grown-up first.' It names a situation a skimmer would recognize, 'kind words' and 'empty' are fair names for 'sweeter and sweeter things' with the loving grown-up missing behind them, and the heading gives 'the words' and 'them' a clear antecedent that the paragraph alone lacks. It opens a new case (a fourth blocker after the intro's three) rather than splitting a line from the one it answers, and with 'If the relief doesn't last', 'How many tries would I give it?' and the other stall cases the set reads as ways progress stalls, not a coverage taxonomy. No linter findings and no row marked PRESENT; the shared word 'words' is the anchor and not a T26 repeat, and I saw no other tell (T06, T11, T19, T22) happening in a six-word case label.
